photoNumbers: User-supplied photo numbers; originals are not distributed with the app.

characters.prompt: Identity-preserving photographic edit for a private iPhone diary: isolate and dress exactly ONE of the MINISO plush pigs in the supplied personal toy photographs. Image 1 shows two copies of the same toy; isolate the RIGHT pig's actual facial pattern and soft seated body. Image 2 supplies more detail of that same plush model; ignore surrounding objects. This should look like a clean cutout product photograph of the user's own stuffed toy after putting a themed hoodie on it. Fidelity to the photographed sewing pattern is paramount. Huge ball-shaped head, slightly broader at the bottom, very full plain cheeks; head is almost twice the width of the soft small clothed torso. Very wide-set, small flat matte dark-brown embroidered dot eyes near the *sides* of the face. A prominent projecting wide horizontal oval muzzle with a pale cream raised outer rim and muted pink fabric center plus two widely separated upright dark brown oval embroidered nostrils. A visible fine center seam runs down the chin from the nose. There is NO mouth anywhere, no smile, no eyebrows, no makeup, no glossy plastic bead eyes. Small triangular pig ears with pink inner embroidery. Smooth short ivory/blush peach velour, no shaggy fleece. Short rounded soft dangling hands, bare pale hoof ends, little feet in front like the actual toy. Neutral sweet blank expression. No bow tie or accessories at the neck: keep the collar plain. Put a thin fabric animal-themed hood lightly over the crown/behind the ears so most of the pig head and both eyes are visible, not a new character's head. Costume as follows: Soft young-leaf sage green hoodie like the green photo outfit, short soft triangular dorsal ridges in pale yellow-green on the cap/back and a little curved green dinosaur tail visible to one side. Bare hooves. No second face on the costume. Frame the entire seated pig near-front at a tiny 8-degree turn, level camera at the pig's eye height (no extreme selfie lens). Both eyes visible. The whole toy and all costume parts fit comfortably, quiet even soft frontal catalog light, soft natural sewing seams, realistic textiles. Center the toy at 83% canvas height, square transparent PNG with generous clear margins on every side. Only the dressed pig—remove all photographed furniture, people, props, other toys and backgrounds. No lettering, product labels or branding.
